about: Rule 2 of parity.py: noise tokens, each masked where it occurs, never a whole field. `scope` is where a pattern applies: `all`, or one output kind (`stdout`, `stderr`, `path` for out/ file names, a file suffix, or one file name). @SCRATCH@ and @TOKEN@ stand for a run's own scratch root and read-coverage token.

patterns.reason: Absolute temporary paths. Every run of one parity session shares this root, so masking it changes no comparison; it keeps the committed cases free of the session stamp.
integrate mints a fresh uuid4 hex per gate-7 run (receipt invocation, read-coverage-tmp-<token> scratch directory). Only that run's own token is masked.
tempfile.mkdtemp's random eight-character suffix on integrate's package backup.
pytest's wall-clock summary (`1 failed in 0.12s`) inside gate 1a and 5 details.
pytest's junit writer records each suite's start time and every duration. The same pytest timing tokens as `in N.NNs`, in the junit evidence file gates 1a and 5 cite.
Traceback frames name the tool's own file and line, which the move changes by construction (B1, B2).
common.write_document writes through tempfile.mkstemp(prefix='.<name>.', suffix='.tmp'), whose eight-character middle is random. Read coverage lists the attempt in attempted_new_output_creations.
teax's runner stages each attempt under a fresh uuid4-hex directory. Read coverage lists the staged write in attempted_new_output_creations.
